original.statement: Gateway API GRPCRoute is moved from v1alpha2 to v1, requiring new CRD installation and migration of existing resources.

decision.reason: [ev-ee4d25413bf4] says GRPCRoute has moved from v1alpha2 to v1 and asks operators to migrate their resources from v1alpha2 to v1. That means the exposed environments are the ones whose manifests use gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1alpha2 GRPCRoute. The proposed gvk-in-use condition matches that exactly, and it is the standard condition for a removed API version. The excerpt also says to install the new CRD, but it does not say that anything fails for Gateway API users who have no GRPCRoute resources, so the condition does not need to be broader.
